Name: Your cat becomes a crab and your horse becomes a shark with human legs wearing red sneakers
Author: soysauceicecream
Description:
I like the beach farm and wanted animals to match my surroundings. I will upload content patcher versions once I figure that out.

Installation:
- Download the file
- navigate to your stardew content folder, commonly within your steamapps folder, open the folder titled 'Animals'
- Backup your files
- Drag and drop the xnb files into your Animals folder, replacing existing files

this file replace the orange cat
